title: Model categories and payment methods
prompt: Complete Pocket Budget's two enums. `Category` must provide a list of all its cases so the picker can show them, and `label(for:)` must read the last four digits out of a card payment.
hints: The protocol that generates a list of every case has "Case" in its name.
The generated list is a static property: `Category.____`.
Inside a `case` pattern, the keyword that binds an associated value to a new constant is the same one you use to declare constants.
explanation:
`CaseIterable` makes the compiler generate `Category.allCases`, an array of every case in declaration order, so `count` is 3. In the switch, `case .card(let lastFour)` matches card payments and binds the associated value to the constant `lastFour` for that branch.

Notice the switch has no `default`. If you add `case transfer(bank: String)` later, this function stops compiling until you handle it, which is exactly what you want.
